forecast.new_method: training mean for each hour, locality and sector
forecast.information: known hour of day; no evaluation targets or history used for fitting

rule.bootstrap: paired within-seed base draws, severities coupled; deterministic singleton run

boundary.supply_formula: critical demand + alpha * minimum locality noncritical demand
boundary.interpretation: first discretionary-action threshold, not infinitesimal critical headroom
boundary.inference: descriptive post-hoc challenge; no tuning, selection or significance claim
